title: Indlela Yokukhuphela Iividiyo ze-Facebook kwi-Gallery Yefowuni
description: Khuphela iividiyo ze-Facebook kwi-Gallery ye-Android ne-iPhone ngaphandle kwe-app. Kopa ilinki yevidiyo, uyincamathisele kwi-I Need Save, uze uyigcine.
body:
I-Facebook igcwele iividiyo ezinomdla, ukusuka kwiiresiphi zokupheka, iingcebiso zokulima igadi, iziqwenga zemidlalo, ukuya kwiividiyo ezihlekisayo ezivela kumaqela owathandayo. Ngelishwa, alikho iqhosha elakhelwe ngaphakathi lokuzigcina ngqo kwi-gallery. Kweli nqaku uza kufunda indlela yokukhuphela iividiyo ze-Facebook kwi-gallery yefowuni yakho usebenzisa i-I Need Save, isixhobo sasimahla esisebenza kwiwebhu onokusisebenzisa ngaphandle kwe-app nangaphandle kokungena.

Yintoni Oyidingayo?

Akukho kuninzi okufunekayo:

  • Ifowuni okanye ikhompyutha ene-browser ne-intanethi.
  • Ilinki yevidiyo ye-Facebook evela kokuthunyelweyo okuvulelekileyo.
  • Indawo encinci engenanto kwisixhobo sakho.

Kuphelele apho. Akufuneki uvule i-akhawunti kwi-I Need Save, kwaye akufuneki ufake iinkcukacha zakho zokungena kwi-Facebook.

Indlela Yokukhuphela Iividiyo ze-Facebook kwiFowuni

Landela la manyathelo, nokuba kwi-Android okanye kwi-iPhone:

  1. Vula i-app ye-Facebook uze ufumane ividiyo ofuna ukuyigcina.
  2. Cofa iqhosha elithi Yabelana (Share) phantsi kwevidiyo.
  3. Khetha Kopa ilinki (Copy link).
  4. Vula i-browser, uze undwendwele i-ineedsave.com.
  5. Ncamathisela ilinki kwibhokisi ekhoyo, okanye ucofe iqhosha elithi Ncamathisela.
  6. Cofa Khuphela uze ulinde kuvele uluhlu lokhetho.
  7. Khetha umgangatho wevidiyo owufunayo. Ukukhuphela kuya kuqala.

Kwezinye iividiyo, iqhosha liya kuqala libonise Iyalungiselela…. Oku kwenzeka xa ividiyo ifuna ukusetyenzwa kuqala, umzekelo xa ividiyo nesandi zidityaniswa okanye i-stream iguqulelwa kwi-MP4. Linda nje, kuba ukukhuphela kuya kuqala ngokuzenzekelayo xa ifayile ilungile.

Indlela Yokukhuphela Iividiyo ze-Facebook kwiKhompyutha

Kwi-laptop okanye kwi-PC, amanyathelo ayafana. Vula i-Facebook kwi-browser, cofa ividiyo oyifunayo, uze ukope ilinki yayo kwimenyu ethi Yabelana okanye kwi-address bar. Vula iphepha lokukhuphela kwithebhu entsha, ncamathisela ilinki, cofa Khuphela, uze ukhethe ukhetho olukhoyo. Ifayile iya kugcinwa kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo).

Iingenelo Zokukhuphela nge-I Need Save

  • Isimahla kwaye ayifuni app. Vula nje isayithi kwi-browser yefowuni okanye yekhompyutha.
  • Akukho kungena. Akufuneki ufake iinkcukacha ze-akhawunti yakho ye-Facebook naphi na.
  • Isebenza nakwamanye amaqonga. Ngaphandle kwe-Facebook, ungagcina neevidiyo ezivela kwi-TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), nakwamanye amaqonga axhaswayo.
  • Kulula ukuyisebenzisa. Isayithi ifumaneka ngeelwimi ezingama-93, kuquka nesiXhosa.

Ukukhetha Umgangatho Wevidiyo Ofanelekileyo

Emva kokuba ilinki iqhutywe, i-I Need Save ikubonisa ukhetho oluninzi. Oko kuvelayo kunokwahluka ngokwevidiyo nganye:

  • Ividiyo kwimigangatho eyahlukeneyo, umzekelo 360p, 720p, okanye 1080p, kuxhomekeke kwividiyo yokuqala.
  • Isandi ngomgangatho wokuqala okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe kwividiyo.
  • Ifoto / Umfanekiso omncinci wevidiyo leyo.

Ngokubanzi, i-1080p inika umfanekiso ocace kakhulu, i-720p ilinganisela phakathi komgangatho nobukhulu befayile, ngelixa i-360p igcina kakhulu idatha nendawo yokugcina. Inkcazelo epheleleyo ikwinqaku elithi umahluko phakathi komgangatho wevidiyo we-360p, 720p ne-1080p.

Ukuze Ividiyo Ivele kwi-Gallery Yefowuni

Le yinxalenye edla ngokudida abantu. Emva kokuba ukukhuphela kugqityiwe, ividiyo ayisoloko ivela ngoko nangoko kwi-gallery. Nantsi inkcazelo.

Kwi-Android

Ividiyo igcinwa kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). I-app ye-Gallery idla ngokuyibonisa, kodwa ngamanye amaxesha ithatha ixesha elincinci. Ukuba ayikaveli, linda kancinci okanye uvule ifolda ethi Downloads nge-app yokulawula iifayile.

Kwi-iPhone nakwi-iPad

Ukuba ukhuphela nge-Safari, ividiyo ingena kwi-app ethi Files (Iifayile), kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). Ukuyidlulisela kwi-app ethi Photos (iiFoto):

  1. Vula i-app ethi Files uze ungene kwifolda ethi Downloads.
  2. Cofa ividiyo osandula ukuyikhuphela.
  3. Cofa iqhosha elithi Share (Yabelana).
  4. Khetha Save Video (Gcina Ividiyo).

Ngoku ividiyo sele ikwi-gallery yakho kwaye ungayidlala njengezinye iividiyo. Iifayile ze-MP4 ezivela kwi-I Need Save zinobude bexesha obuchanekileyo, ngoko zidlala kakuhle kwii-app ze-gallery.

Icebiso: Ukuba udla ngokukhuphela iividiyo, coca ifolda ethi Downloads rhoqo ukuze indawo yokugcina yefowuni yakho ingagcwali ngokukhawuleza.

Ividiyo ye-Facebook Ayikhutshelwa?

Ezinye iintlobo zomxholo azinakukhutshelwa:

  • Iividiyo ezivela kwii-akhawunti okanye kumaqela abucala.
  • Umxholo obonakala kuphela emva kokungena.
  • Iividiyo ezithintelwe kwimimandla ethile.

Qinisekisa kwakhona ukuba ilinki oyincamathiselayo yilinki yevidiyo, hayi ilinki yephepha okanye yeprofayile. Ukuba awuqinisekanga, yikope kwakhona kwiqhosha elithi Yabelana levidiyo.

Ikhuselekile Kwaye Inoxanduva

Ividiyo idluliselwa ngqo isuka kwi-Facebook iye kwisixhobo sakho kwaye ayigcinwa kwiseva ye-I Need Save. Noko ke, sebenzisa oko ukukhupheleyo kuphela ukuze kube kokwakho. Hlonipha ilungelo lokushicilela (copyright) lomdali wevidiyo: cela imvume phambi kokuyipapasha kwakhona uze ukhankanye umnini wayo wokuqala.

Imibuzo Ebuzwa Rhoqo

Ndingazikhuphela iividiyo ze-Facebook ngaphandle kwe-app?

Ewe. I-I Need Save isebenza ngqo kwi-browser, ngoko akufuneki ufake nayiphi na i-app.

Kutheni ividiyo ingaveli kwangoko kwi-gallery?

Kwi-Android, i-Gallery ngamanye amaxesha idinga ixesha elincinci ukubonisa iifayile ezintsha. Kwi-iPhone, ividiyo iqala ingene kwi-app ethi Files, uze kufuneke ukhethe Save Video ukuze ingene kwi-Photos.

Ndingathatha isandi sodwa?

Ewe. Khetha ukhetho oluthi Isandi, nokuba ngumgangatho wokuqala okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps.
